issue_request: The Published/Persuasive PA issue asked to clean up repetitive rendered Sex for Clinical Use extension descriptions on the 2022Sep extension page and add a break before the SFCU history/practices content. Jira's final resolution accepted the concern but stated that the work needed to be addressed in publisher tooling, with HL7/kindling#103 filed.
initial_application: No core source-changing FHIR-39204 commit was found. Jira comments and the linked Zulip discussion say the extension definition was authored once and the repetition came from the publisher rendering that definition in multiple extension page locations.
additional_context: Current FHIR core no longer has an active StructureDefinition source file for the old patient-sexForClinicalUse extension page; only OID/narrative references remain. The maintained SPCU extension definition is now in the FHIR Extension Pack as patient-sexParameterForClinicalUse. HL7/kindling#103 was closed in 2025 with the assessment that the duplicate rendering was no longer a problem because extensions are no longer in core and the description/definition table columns no longer duplicate the content.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch and made no FHIR core source changes. Editing current core source would not address the historical extension-page publisher behavior and could alter unrelated current SPCU guidance.
